description: Revert to the stable 0.055 Matrix LR configuration (consistently ~0.9884) and reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 100 to increase gradient accumulation steps (12.8 -> ~10.24 steps? No, 2^19/100/2048 = 25.6 steps) and reduce memory pressure per micro-step, potentially improving convergence stability while avoiding the divergence risks at 0.06 LR and crashes at larger batch sizes.
